Run order: `00_survey_data.Rmd` (samples and site registry) ->
`python/environmental_timeseries_pull/update_env_cache.py` (pulls climate data for any
registry cell-dates not yet cached) -> this script (climate and KG joins, model data).

## Setup

```{r}
#| eval: true
#| output: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show setup code"

# setup
librarian::shelf(tidyverse, here, janitor, terra, arrow)

source(here("size_bd_unified", "env_functions.R"))

bd_model_clean = readRDS(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "bd_survey_clean.rds"))

```

## Environmental data
To support comparing Bd prevalence and loads between sites and species across a range of environmental conditions, I incorporated local (~5 km) daily maximum temperature (CHIRTS) and daily precipitation (CHIRPS) time series. Following Sonn et al. 2019 [sonn2019effects], I created 10-day and 30-day means (for tempurature) and sums (for precipitation). Preliminary model fitting showed stronger relationships between Bd prevalence and 10-day lag products, while Bd load showed stronger relationships with 30-day lag products, similar to Sonn et al. 2019.

### Climate by grid cell
```{r}
#| warning: false
#| code-fold: true
#| code-summary: "Show environmental data code"

# CHIRPS and CHIRTS share a 0.05 deg grid; sites are mapped to cells by update_env_cache.py.
# rolling windows (10/30-day precip sums and temp means, past-year weekly SDs) in env_functions.R
site_cells = read_site_cells(here("size_bd_unified", "intermediates", "site_registry_cells.csv"),
                             bd_model_clean$site)

env_agg_all = build_env_agg(unique(site_cells$cell_id))

bd_model_env = join_env(bd_model_clean, site_cells, env_agg_all)

bd_env = bd_model_env %>%
  mutate(
    precip_mm_10_z = as.numeric(scale(precip_mm_10_day_sum, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    precip_mm_30_z = as.numeric(scale(precip_mm_30_day_sum, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    temp_c_10_z = as.numeric(scale(temp_c_10_day_mean, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE)),
    temp_c_30_z = as.numeric(scale(temp_c_30_day_mean, center = TRUE, scale = TRUE))) %>%
  select(taxon_capture,
         everything())

```

## KG zones
```{r}

kg_key = read_csv(here("data", "koppen_geiger_tif", "legend.csv")) %>%
  select(-rgb) %>%
  rename_with(function(x) { paste0("kg_", x) })

all_sites = bd_env %>%
  group_by(site, population, country) %>%
  summarize(site_latitude = mean(site_latitude),
            site_longitude = mean(site_longitude),
            taxa = paste0(sort(unique(taxon_capture)), collapse = ", "),
            taxa_n = n_distinct(taxon_capture),
            adult_n = sum(life_stage_simple == "adult"),
            subadult_n = sum(life_stage_simple == "subadult"),
            .groups = "drop")

site_coords = cbind(lon = all_sites$site_longitude,
                    lat = all_sites$site_latitude)

kg_rast = rast(here("data", "koppen_geiger_tif", "1991_2020", "koppen_geiger_0p00833333.tif"))

kg_extract = extract(kg_rast, site_coords) %>%
  dplyr::rename(kg_id = koppen_geiger_0p00833333) %>%
  mutate(kg_id = if_else(kg_id == 29, 19, kg_id))

all_sites_kg = bind_cols(all_sites,
                          kg_extract) %>%
  left_join(kg_key, by = "kg_id")

peace = get_dupes(all_sites_kg, site)

bd_env_kg = bd_env %>%
  dplyr::select(-site_latitude,
                -site_longitude) %>%
  left_join(all_sites_kg %>%
  dplyr::select(site,
                site_latitude,
                site_longitude,
                kg_code_1,
                kg_code_2,
                kg_code_3), by = "site")

ggplot(all_sites_kg, aes(x = kg_code_2, fill = kg_code_3)) +
  geom_bar() +
  scale_y_log10()

```
# checks
```{r}

count_na = function(df, cols) {
  df |>
    summarise(across(all_of(cols), ~sum(is.na(.)))) |>
    pivot_longer(everything(),
                 names_to  = "column",
                 values_to = "n_na")
}

check_na_cols = c("bd_load_co0_density",
                  "bd_load_co30_density",
                  "bd_load_co100_density",
                  "bd_load_co300_density",
                  "bd_load_co1000_density",
                  "life_stage_simple",
                  "taxon_capture",
                  "precip_mm_10_z",
                  "temp_c_30_z",
                  "kg_code_3",
                  "population",
                  "date",
                  "year")

na_col_check = count_na(bd_env_kg, check_na_cols)

if (sum(na_col_check$n_na) > 0) {
  print(filter(na_col_check, n_na > 0))
  stop("NAs found in model variable columns. Please review.")
}

```

# svl distributions by species
```{r}
#| fig-width: 14
#| fig-height: 14

# svl histograms per species, stacked by life stage, with the subadult / adult cutoff(s) from
# svl_stage_cutoffs.R (the same rules 00_survey_data.Rmd uses to assign stages). each sample's
# rule is looked up by species and data source: external datasets by their project name, all
# other samples by the RIBBiTR database rules. species staged from field labels get no line.
source(here("size_bd_unified", "svl_stage_cutoffs.R"))

stage_colors = c(subadult = "#56B4E9", adult = "#0072B2")
n_svl_bins = 30
external_datasets = unique(svl_stage_cutoffs$dataset[svl_stage_cutoffs$dataset != "ribbitr_db"])

svl_data = brms_data %>%
  mutate(dataset = if_else(project %in% external_datasets, as.character(project), "ribbitr_db"))

# rules in use: one row per species x data source present in the data
svl_rules = svl_data %>%
  distinct(taxon_capture, dataset) %>%
  left_join(svl_stage_cutoffs, by = c("taxon_capture", "dataset"))

# every species x source in the data should have a rule
svl_rules %>% filter(is.na(stage_rule))

# check: do the stages in the data follow the cutoffs? counts of subadults at or above, and
# adults below, their cutoff (0 expected; daversa2026 subadults below 40 come from field labels,
# which is consistent)
svl_data %>%
  inner_join(svl_rules %>% filter(stage_rule == "svl_cutoff"), by = c("taxon_capture", "dataset")) %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, dataset, svl_cutoff_mm) %>%
  summarise(n_subadult_above = sum(life_stage_simple == "subadult" & svl_mm >= svl_cutoff_mm),
            n_adult_below = sum(life_stage_simple == "adult" & svl_mm < svl_cutoff_mm),
            .groups = "drop") %>%
  filter(n_subadult_above > 0 | n_adult_below > 0)

# panel titles: note species staged (partly) from field labels
svl_panels = svl_rules %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  summarise(field_label = any(stage_rule == "field_label", na.rm = TRUE), .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(panel = str_to_sentence(gsub("_", " ", taxon_capture)),
         panel = if_else(field_label, paste0(panel, "\n(stage from field labels)"), panel))

svl_lines = svl_rules %>%
  filter(stage_rule == "svl_cutoff") %>%
  distinct(taxon_capture, svl_cutoff_mm) %>%
  left_join(svl_panels, by = "taxon_capture")

# bin per species so each panel gets its own binwidth
svl_binned = svl_data %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture) %>%
  mutate(svl_min = min(svl_mm),
         binwidth = max((max(svl_mm) - svl_min) / n_svl_bins, 0.1),   # floor for constant svl
         bin_mid = svl_min + (pmin(floor((svl_mm - svl_min) / binwidth), n_svl_bins - 1) + 0.5) * binwidth) %>%
  group_by(taxon_capture, life_stage_simple, bin_mid, binwidth) %>%
  summarise(n = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(svl_panels, by = "taxon_capture") %>%
  mutate(life_stage_simple = factor(life_stage_simple, levels = c("subadult", "adult")))

(svl_hist_unified = ggplot(svl_binned, aes(x = bin_mid, y = n, fill = life_stage_simple)) +
  geom_col(aes(width = binwidth), position = "stack") +
  geom_vline(data = svl_lines, aes(xintercept = svl_cutoff_mm), linetype = "dashed", color = "grey30") +
  facet_wrap(~ panel, scales = "free") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = stage_colors) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.1))) +
  labs(x = "SVL (mm); dashed = subadult / adult cutoff (svl_stage_cutoffs.R)",
       y = "Samples", fill = "Life stage") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom",
        strip.text = element_text(face = "italic")))

```
